title: Kenafric employee onboarding submission (1.0)
description: The employee onboarding submission. Sent as the `payload` part of one multipart/form-data request; each document travels in the same request as its own part, named file0, file1, ... and mapped by documents[].field. additionalProperties is false throughout and every listed property is required even when its value is null, so the builder always writes the whole object.

submissionId.description: UUID v4, generated on first mount and reused by every document upload and every submit attempt. A repeat must be rejected, not filed twice.

employee.description: Only the task id, and only ever the one the signed link token established. There is deliberately no shape here for an id the browser was told rather than given.

personalEmailChanged.description: True when the employee changed the address the link was sent to. WF-15 writes it back to the Employee record.

mobile.description: E.164. The form asks for the country and the national digits separately and composes them. A Kenyan number is checked properly by the app (nine digits after +254, starting 7 or 1); other countries get a length check only, because this form has no business deciding what a valid Ugandan mobile looks like.

bank.description: Three answers on the wire; n8n concatenates them into the single Bank Account Details text field, in the order listed here. Asked separately because one box produced "Stephen Wahito 0110123456789", which a payroll clerk cannot safely split back up.

accountNumber.description: Whitespace removed by the app — people group the digits, and a payroll file cannot.

helbLoanStatus.description: A label, never an option UUID. n8n resolves it against the live field schema.

documents.description: What is attached to this request. `field` names the multipart part carrying the bytes. clickupFieldName is the pairing key WF-15 Trigger B matches on; the filename is for humans and must never be parsed.

field.description: The multipart part holding this document's bytes. Indexed rather than named after the document, because a binary property called file_drivers-licence is awkward to reach in an n8n expression and one called file3 is not.

notProvided.description: Why each missing document is missing. HR reads this list, so "skipped" and "too-large" have to mean different things.

advisoriesAcknowledged.description: Codes of the warnings the employee was shown and explicitly waved through.

consent.description: "They consented" is only meaningful alongside what they were shown, so the wording's own version travels with it.

clickupFieldName.description: The contract with WF-15 Trigger B. Note the slash in NHIF/SHA, the apostrophe and -ce in Driver's Licence, and the numeral in Last 3 Payslips.
